description: This class functions as a factory for creating RequestBodyMapHandler instances based on the content type of the incoming ServletRequest. It maintains a registry of handlers (such as JSONRequestBodyMapHandler) for specific content types and provides methods to retrieve the appropriate handler and extract a map from the request body.

classes.name: RequestBodyMapHandlerFactory
classes.description: Factory class that provides the proper RequestBodyMapHandler based on the content type of the ServletRequest.

methods.name: getRequestBodyMapHandler
methods.description: Returns the appropriate RequestBodyMapHandler instance based on the content type of the request.

methods.name: extractMapFromRequestBody
methods.description: Extracts a map from the request body using the appropriate handler, based on the request's content type.
